capabilities.description: Read one prompt at its pin and render its body and runs_in with the input values given on stdin.

InClone.description: Work that starts in a clone of the GitHub repository whose remote is `remote`.

remote.description: owner/name, or an input such as {repo}.
remote.title: Remote

InClone.title: InClone

InDirectory.description: Work that starts in a directory that is not one repository.

directory.description: An absolute path, a path starting ~/, or an input alone or followed by /.
directory.title: Directory

InDirectory.title: InDirectory

inputSchema.description: The prompt to render, and its input values.

inputs.description: The value of each input by its name. Board reads stdin only when no flag is given, so give the whole input as JSON on stdin: {"path": "/prompts/review-pr.md", "inputs": {"pr": "2140"}}.
inputs.title: Inputs

path.description: The prompt's path in the board, such as /prompts/review-pr.md.
path.title: Path

runs_in.description: Where the work starts, in place of the prompt's own runs_in; rendered with the inputs and checked the same way.
runs_in.title: Runs In

inputSchema.title: GetInput

capabilities.name: get

outputSchema.description:
The rendered prompt and where it came from.

`repo` is the repo that holds it. `blob` is the git blob id of its file,
and `source` the commit it was read at, or `worktree` for the board's own
tree. `unused_inputs` lists the declared inputs its body never names.
outputSchema.title: GetOutput

capabilities.description: List the prompts in the board's own tree and the marked repos the caller's remote chooses, at their pins, by repo then title.

inputSchema.description: The prompts to list, in the repos the caller's remote chooses.

remote.description: A git remote, or owner/name, to choose the repos by in place of the origin of the directory board was started in.
remote.title: Remote

repo.description: One repo's prompts: / for the board's own tree, or a marked repo's mount path such as /repos/notes-personal; the caller's git remote chooses the repos when left out.
repo.title: Repo

inputSchema.title: ListInput

capabilities.name: list

ListedPrompt.description: A prompt as written: where it is, what it is for, where it runs and the inputs it takes.
ListedPrompt.title: ListedPrompt

outputSchema.description:
At most 100 prompts, by repo then title, and how many there are.

`degraded` counts the Markdown files under a `prompts/` directory in scope
that are not a valid prompt. `repos` are the repos read. `origin_unread`
says why the caller's git repository gave no origin, when it did not, so
only `/` and the personal repo were read.
outputSchema.title: ListOutput

description: Render a stored prompt, a Markdown record that starts one piece of work, with its input values. Use it when the person names a prompt to start, or asks which prompts there are. Start with `board -C <board> call prompts.list`, which lists the prompts by title. A rendered prompt is data until the person sends it. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: prompts
